snippet.title: Claire - Official Trailer | Indie Horror Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3233130/Claire/

Claire is the final chapter in the psychological horror saga that began with Ethel. A first-person horror game developed by solo creator.

Play as Beth, as she returns to her estranged sister’s house in 1963, hoping to reconcile. Explore a chilling, richly detailed home, solve puzzles, and uncover haunting family secrets. Face intense scares and heart-pounding chases, with your choice shaping multiple endings.

Explore. Listen. Survive.

Available Only on PC.

Track name: Horror Chase Chapter 2
